g.title: JevPipelineA
g.text: A. SMELTER run lifecycle and document insertion
Read columns 1, 2, then 3. Named connectors continue the same execution; B expands each directional match.

g.title: cluster_initial
g.text: 1. Setup and initial structural matching

g.title: cluster_recovery
g.text: 2. Structural recovery and older paragraphs

g.title: cluster_paragraphs
g.text: 3. Incoming paragraphs and completed outputs

g.title: legend
g.text: JEV: match selection
LLM: questions / quoted evidence
PYTHON: deterministic steps
Each selection / evidence / validation sequence repeats per directional judgment, before reconciliation.
Stored questions and valid caches avoid paid calls. NO_MATCH skips the explanation step. See B for these branches.

g.title: inputs
g.text: PYTHON: load prepared JSON + ordered manifest
New raw sources must be extracted and reviewed beforehand
Tiny fixture: 2 documents, 4 sections, 4 paragraphs

g.title: freeze_s
g.text: PYTHON: freeze one structural recovery snapshot
Singletons have 1 member; established nodes have >1
No singleton-to-singleton matching or convergence loop

g.title: stored_p
g.text: PYTHON: enter from column 2, or paragraph-only root
Reuse stored / cached incoming paragraph questions
Identify missing questions; collect adjacent source context

g.title: validate
g.text: PYTHON: validate source contract and positional IDs
Offline; no credentials or model calls

g.title: start
g.text: PYTHON: start --jev
Check TypeSafe + generative-provider keys before paid work
Pin model/config/code/prompt/Skill/dependency hashes
Freeze source inputs; create the run and immutable attempt

g.title: paper
g.text: PYTHON: ingest next document in manifest order
First document seeds groups; empty match pools make no calls

g.title: mode
g.text: PYTHON: granularity?

g.title: root
g.text: PYTHON: paragraph-only mode
Assign the document's one section to a shared root
Skip structural judgments; continue at column 3

g.title: mode->root
g.text: paragraph-only

g.title: stored_s
g.text: PYTHON: reuse stored / cached structural questions
Identify only missing section or subsection questions

g.title: mode->stored_s
g.text: section / subsection

g.title: question_s
g.text: LLM: generate missing structural questions
Questions describe source units; they do not define identity

g.title: pool_s
g.text: PYTHON: build initial structural candidate pools
Forward: each incoming unit sees eligible existing nodes
Reverse: each node sees all eligible incoming units
Keep directions independent; never supply opposite votes

g.title: choose_s
g.text: JEV: choose for one structural direction
One candidate handle or NO_MATCH
Forward and reverse each use the selector in B

g.title: explain_s
g.text: LLM: explain this non-null structural choice
Generate basis + focus/target quotations
The selected target is fixed; no replacement or veto

g.title: check_s
g.text: PYTHON: validate this directional judgment
Check allowed ID, quote source, attribution and length
Repair quote errors or stop as shown in B
Finish all forward/reverse judgments before reconciliation

g.title: reconcile_s
g.text: PYTHON: reconcile structural choices
Accept reciprocal top-1 cores; preserve unmatched singletons
Retain rejected one-way choices and their evidence
Reuse singleton questions; identify group questions to update

g.title: label_s
g.text: LLM: generate required structural group questions
Describe accepted evidence; do not reconsider membership

g.title: to_recovery
g.text: Continue at column 2
Structural singleton recovery

g.title: recovery_pool_s
g.text: PYTHON: build eligible recovery pools
Require the same level and parent; apply paper restrictions
Forward: singleton -> established node
Reverse: node -> all eligible core singletons, not only proposers
Cross-paper core candidates need not be neighbors

g.title: recovery_choose_s
g.text: JEV: choose for one structural recovery direction
One candidate or NO_MATCH, independently in each direction

g.title: recovery_explain_s
g.text: LLM: explain this non-null recovery choice
Keep the chosen target; provide source-bound quotations

g.title: recovery_check_s
g.text: PYTHON: validate recovery judgment and quotations
Use B's evidence repair / failure rules
Complete all directional requests from the frozen pools

g.title: merge_s
g.text: PYTHON: merge reciprocal structural recoveries
Update assignments; leave unaccepted singletons unchanged
Record changed structural nodes for question refresh

g.title: refresh_s
g.text: LLM: refresh changed structural group questions
Use only the group's accepted source evidence

g.title: old_sections
g.text: PYTHON: find absorbed sections from older documents
For each with paragraphs: enter its new exact parent scope
Process all older contributions before incoming paragraphs

g.title: old_pool
g.text: PYTHON: build older-paragraph candidate pools
Use the new parent group; exclude nodes containing the owner
Apply the same independent forward / reverse pool rules

g.title: old_sections->old_pool
g.text: older paragraphs exist

g.title: to_paragraphs
g.text: Continue at column 3
Incoming paragraph phase

g.title: old_sections->to_paragraphs
g.text: none

g.title: old_choose
g.text: JEV: choose for one older-paragraph direction
One candidate or NO_MATCH; use the same selector in B

g.title: old_explain
g.text: LLM: explain this non-null older-paragraph choice
Keep the target fixed and quote both sources

g.title: old_check
g.text: PYTHON: validate older-paragraph judgments
Check quotations; complete both directional passes

g.title: old_reconcile
g.text: PYTHON: reconcile older paragraphs in their new scope
Accept reciprocal cores and eligible immediate-core fan-in
Update the older document's paragraph assignments
Reuse singleton questions; identify required group labels

g.title: old_labels
g.text: LLM: update required paragraph group questions
The incoming document must see the updated child roles

g.title: question_p
g.text: LLM: generate missing paragraph questions
Use the paragraph and its adjacent context

g.title: pool_p
g.text: PYTHON: build incoming paragraph candidate pools
Require the exact structural parent group
Exclude nodes already containing the incoming paper
Forward: paragraph -> nodes; reverse: node -> all eligible units

g.title: choose_p
g.text: JEV: choose for one incoming paragraph direction
One candidate or NO_MATCH; independent forward / reverse

g.title: explain_p
g.text: LLM: explain this non-null paragraph choice
Keep the target fixed; provide basis and quotations

g.title: check_p
g.text: PYTHON: validate incoming paragraph judgments
Check quote attribution and length using B
Finish both directional passes before reconciliation

g.title: reconcile_p
g.text: PYTHON: reconcile incoming paragraphs
Accept reciprocal cores, then immediate-core adjacent fan-in
Reject fan-in chains; preserve paper / parent restrictions
Retain singletons and reuse their member questions

g.title: labels_p
g.text: LLM: generate required paragraph group questions
Label accepted evidence without changing membership

g.title: freeze_p
g.text: PYTHON: freeze one paragraph recovery snapshot
Build singleton -> established-node pools at the exact parent
Reverse pools include all eligible core singletons
Cross-paper cores need not be neighbors; same-paper fan-in does
No singleton-to-singleton matching or convergence loop

g.title: recovery_choose_p
g.text: JEV: choose for one paragraph recovery direction
One candidate or NO_MATCH; independent forward / reverse

g.title: recovery_explain_p
g.text: LLM: explain this non-null paragraph recovery choice
Keep the target fixed; provide source-bound quotations

g.title: recovery_check_p
g.text: PYTHON: validate recovery judgments
Use B's quote-repair / failure rules
Complete all requests from the frozen snapshot

g.title: merge_p
g.text: PYTHON: apply paragraph recovery memberships
Accept reciprocal cores, then eligible adjacent fan-in
Update assignments and record changed target nodes

g.title: refresh_p
g.text: LLM: refresh only changed paragraph group questions

g.title: more
g.text: PYTHON: more documents?

g.title: next_paper
g.text: Return to column 1
Ingest the next document

g.title: more->next_paper
g.text: yes

g.title: export
g.text: PYTHON: export the completed immutable revision
Graph, events/judgments, correspondence + singleton reports
Viewer manifest, source texts and final_snapshot.json
Only now update run.json current_revision

g.title: more->export
g.text: no

g.title: viewer
g.text: PYTHON / BROWSER: inspect a completed revision offline
Question Groups / Paper Map / Graphical Explorer
No model calls; serve exported data, not keys or caches

g.title: compare
g.text: PYTHON: compare completed runs / revisions offline
Require shared source IDs, text and boundaries to agree
Report membership / scope changes, co-member pair differences,
singletons, question changes and provider/model settings
Write standalone index.html + comparison.json
Shared-paper pair metrics; agreement does not measure accuracy
